traffic_intensity.label: Traffic intensity
traffic_intensity.description: Higher means heavier perceived motor traffic.

quietness.label: Quietness
quietness.description: Higher means a quieter perceived street environment.

shade.label: Shade
shade.description: Higher means more perceived shade at street level.

naturalness.label: Naturalness
naturalness.description: Higher means a more natural-looking street environment; this does not specifically measure water or parks.

scenic_appeal.label: Scenic appeal
scenic_appeal.description: Higher means more visually appealing scenery.

historic_character.label: Historic character
historic_character.description: Higher means a stronger perceived historic character.

liveliness.label: Liveliness
liveliness.description: Higher means more perceived street activity and liveliness.

visual_openness.label: Visual openness
visual_openness.description: Higher means a more open visual field at street level.

examples: A quiet ride with shade, avoid traffic
